name: bizplug-home-health
description: The home health & hospice plug-in from BizPlug. Main function: request a care assessment. It works from the business's own published profile, covering services, coverage areas and intake enquiries, and sends requests to the business to confirm. It never takes payment and only shares what the business has published. Scheduling and information only: never give medical, mental-health or clinical advice, and never ask for symptoms or records. Provided by BizPlug: https://www.bizplug.ai, info@bizplug.ai.
